Rapido launches Ownly food delivery app in Hyderabad

Rapido has launched its food delivery application, Ownly, in Hyderabad. This marks the app's expansion to its second city, following an initial launch in Bengaluru. Ownly aims to operate on a zero-commission model. Rapido plans to scale the food delivery service to all metropolitan areas in India during the October-December quarter.
